# Machine profiles file

<!-- Generated by `chipload reference`; do not edit. Regenerate with CHIPLOAD_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p chipload-cli --test guide. -->

Your machine profiles (`machines.json` in the settings folder) and the files `machine export` writes. Lengths in mm, feeds in mm/min.

Schema version 2. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

## The file

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default_machine` | string or null | no | The machine a new project starts with. |
| `machines` | list of [MachineProfile](#machineprofile) | yes |  |
| `schema_version` | `2` | yes |  |
| `written_by` | string or null | no |  |

## MachineProfile

One machine profile: a project's machine values plus the spoilboard allowance.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_feed` | number or null | no |  |
| `max_overcut` | number | yes | Kept under `stock` in projects; it is about the spoilboard, so it belongs here. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `post` | string | yes |  |
| `safe_z` | number | yes |  |
| `spindle` | [Spindle](#spindle) | yes |  |
| `tool_change` | [ToolChange](#toolchange) | yes | One file per tool group or one file with M6 (machines.json 2). |
| `travel` | [Travel](#travel) or null | no |  |
| `work_zero` | [WorkZero](#workzero) | yes | The work zero this machine is usually set up with. |

## Spindle

- `"cw"`: M3

- `"ccw"`: M4

## StockCorner

One of: `"center"`, `"bottom_left"`, `"bottom_right"`, `"top_left"`, `"top_right"`.

## ToolChange

How a job with several tool groups is written (docs/specs/tool-per-operation.md §3).

- `"files"`: One G-code file per tool group; the user changes the tool and sets Z zero between.

- `"program"`: One file with `T<n> M6` at each change, for a sender that handles it.

## Travel

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |
| `z` | number | yes |  |

## WorkZero

Where the G-code's X0 Y0 is. The geometry never moves; only the output is translated.

- object: The drawing's own origin (the only choice before work_zero existed). An empty struct variant, not a unit one, so serde refuses stray fields here too.

- object: A corner or the centre of the stock, as placed by `stock.origin`.

- object: Any point, in drawing coordinates (mm).
